instruction.thesis: The BTC put-call exhaustion/reversal thesis (H-069 promoted) required a P/C ratio spike above 1.0 during consolidation as the entry signal. Since entry, btc_spot has moved only -0.06% ($76,989 → $76,942) over 25 hours with no meaningful upside follow-through. The btc_pm_iv has spiked dramatically from 35.5% to 46.2% (97th percentile of 30d range), which is unusual and suggests options market stress rather than the calm consolidation the thesis expected. BTC is at the 11th percentile of its 7d range, meaning it has drifted lower within the range rather than bouncing. The setup-family (btc_put_call_exhaustion_reversal) has 0/4 wins on clean live trades with avg P&L of -2.05%. With 25h elapsed and only 47h remaining before expiry, the risk/reward of holding a -0.06% position with a 1.5% stop against a setup family with 0% win rate is unfavorable. Closing to preserve capital.
